title: Wayfare Pass Payment History and Held-Out Amounts on Wayfare Rides Fares
content:
**Payment history rule.** When a rider pays an unpaid fare on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the payment-history factor in the held-out amount counts the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** membership fee payments declined for the rider in the last 3 months — the declined fee payment entries on the rider's Wayfare Pass record.

| Wayfare Pass fee payments declined in the last 3 months | Payment-history factor |
|---|---|
| none | 1.0 (clean payment-history factor) |
| exactly one | 0.5 (one-decline factor) |
| two or more | not raised |

None takes the clean payment-history factor of 1.0; exactly one takes the one-decline factor of 0.5; two or more leave the factor where it stands.

## Cases (hypothetical riders)

- A rider whose only declined fee payments both fall more than 3 months back: none in the last 3 months, 1.0.
- A rider with one declined fee payment last month: 0.5.
- A rider with declines in each of the last two months: two, not raised.
- A rider who has never held Wayfare Pass: no declined fee payments, 1.0.
